description: This file defines a React functional component called Header, responsible for rendering the top navigation bar of the CyberRecon Dashboard. It manages theme toggling (auto, dark, light) and sidebar toggle via UI state.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: React functional component rendering the header UI with theme toggle and sidebar toggle functionality.
